name: Telecomunicações Brasileiras S.A. - Telebras
summary: Telecomunicações Brasileiras S.A. - Telebras provides multimedia communication services. It provides support services for internet connection for universities, research centers, schools, hospitals, service points, community telecenters, regional offices, and others; infrastructure and support networks for telecommunications services; and broadband internet connection services for end users, as well as implements private communication networks. The company is also involved in the leasing of satellite capacity; and rental of optical cables, routers, and infrastructure for satellites. Telecomunicações Brasileiras S.A. - Telebras was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Brasília, Brazil.
